article.body: This research explores the energy efficiency of locally deployed Large Language Models (LLMs) on consumer hardware.  The study aims to benchmark the GPU power consumption associated with these models.  It's a preliminary quantitative analysis, and the researchers are looking for independent evidence to confirm their findings.
